name: Battle Live: Halloween Live
source:
Pride Park is preparing for it's annual Halloween Live, where after the regular Battle Live two units face off to end the night of horrors. 

Amidst the planning and organizing, the two units chosen to be the stars reminisce about the year prior...

[From [url=https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/halloween-live] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
普莱德公园正在为其一年一度的万圣节现场做准备，在常规的现场战斗之后，两个单位将对峙以结束恐怖之夜。

在策划和组织过程中，被选为明星的两个单位回忆了前一年的情景……

[来自[url=https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/halloween-live] itch.io[/url]]
